results.summary_before: This project implements a 16-bit Izhikevich neuron model in Verilog, which simulates spiking neuron dynamics using 16-bit arithmetic. It accepts an 8-bit input current and outputs an 8-bit state variable along with a spike signal. Testing is done via a supplied testbench that checks reset behavior, sub-threshold non-spiking, and supra-threshold spiking conditions. The design is notable for its efficient implementation of a biologically plausible neuron model, with no external hardware required.
